errors.text: The intervention is framed as a generic property-prediction model rather than a machine-learning interatomic potential combined with free-energy perturbation.
It omits the TaVCrW BCC refractory alloy, 0 GPa condition, 2000–2400 K range, 3456-atom supercell, and GGA-PBE/LDA calculations.

The proposed mechanism concerns single-phase formation descriptors and does not explain MTP-to-DFT phase-space matching, low energy-difference variance, or rapid FEP convergence relative to thermodynamic integration.
It provides no quantitative predictions such as 80% resource savings, approximately 20-fold acceleration, agreement within 0.5 meV/atom, or the electronic and short-range-order melting-point shifts.
The cited evidence primarily supports HEA compositional scale and phase classification or stability screening, not accurate fusion and liquid free-energy calculations.
The falsification rule has no predefined error tolerances, benchmark system, pressure or temperature points, or comparison against the relevant FEP, TI, DFT, and CALPHAD references.
